name: transcript-compress
description: Compresses old Claude transcripts in place to free disk space, losslessly: Windows and macOS use the file system's own compression, so /resume still works. Off by default: Claude suggests it at a natural break when a lot is waiting, or turn on Always on.

autoCompress.title: Always on
autoCompress.description: Compress old transcripts by itself, at most once a day, a few seconds after a session starts. Off: nothing runs until you say yes or type /compress-transcripts.

minAgeDays.title: Minimum age (days)
minAgeDays.description: Only transcripts untouched for at least this many days are compressed.

suggestAtMB.title: Suggest from (MB)
suggestAtMB.description: Claude suggests a run, at most once a week, when old transcripts waiting add up to this many MB. 0 never suggests.
